author_formula_reference.author_scope: Damodaran2009 Toyota illustrations separate operating asset value, cash/nonoperating assets, debt/minority and matching shares. This candidate map is project research adaptation, not author validation of VRAIN.

candidate_mappings.why_not_adopted: 中間期末の帳簿現金/現金同等物対応は公表されたが、評価時点との対応、運転資金需要/拘束・余剰性、営業価値との重複を点検していない。2つの138を足さない。
株単位は既存normalizer未対応。期末自己株はdashで0と確定せず、net shares/希薄化/権利・株主価値帰属と評価時点の適合も未確認。
短期借入金の表示dashは全金融負債/他請求権の範囲を立証せず0化不可。残高/返済CF/負債時価の概念も同一視しない。

other_required_inputs: Future FCFF, terminal FCFF, cost/g, non-operating assets and minority inputs remain unresolved; nonconsolidated reporting is not a substitute for explicit adopted zero values.
CFO223_is_not_FCFF: Existing interim CFO223百万円 is a reported half-year cashflow, not an adopted forecast FCFF or operating enterprise value. No CFO-to-FCFF bridge, extrapolation or new valuation is performed.
